@@ -0,0 +1,63 @@
+import pytest
+
+from jinja2 import DictLoader
+from jinja2 import Environment
+from jinja2 import TemplateNotFound
+from jinja2.loaders import ModuleLoader
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "extensions, expected",
+    [
+        (["html"], ["a.html", "nested/d.html"]),
+        (["html", "txt"], ["a.html", "b.txt", "nested/d.html"]),
+        ([], []),
+    ],
+)
+def test_combined_listing(extensions, expected):
+    names = ["a.html", "b.txt", "c.HTML", "nested/d.html", "reject.html", "plain"]
+    env = Environment(loader=DictLoader(dict.fromkeys(names, "ok")))
+    assert env.list_templates(
+        extensions=extensions, filter_func=lambda name: not name.startswith("reject")
+    ) == expected
+
+
+def test_standalone_selection_is_unchanged():
+    env = Environment(loader=DictLoader({"b.txt": "", "a.html": "", "plain": ""}))
+    assert env.list_templates() == ["a.html", "b.txt", "plain"]
+    assert env.list_templates(extensions=["html"]) == ["a.html"]
+    assert env.list_templates(filter_func=lambda name: name == "plain") == ["plain"]
+
+
+def test_combined_predicate_exception_propagates():
+    env = Environment(loader=DictLoader({"a.html": "ok"}))
+
+    def predicate(name):
+        raise ValueError("selection failed")
+
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="selection failed"):
+        env.list_templates(extensions=["html"], filter_func=predicate)
+
+
+def test_compile_only_combined_selection(tmp_path):
+    env = Environment(
+        loader=DictLoader(
+            {
+                "keep.html": "selected",
+                "reject.html": "{% if %}",
+                "other.txt": "{% if %}",
+            }
+        )
+    )
+    env.compile_templates(
+        tmp_path,
+        extensions=["html"],
+        filter_func=lambda name: name != "reject.html",
+        zip=None,
+        ignore_errors=False,
+    )
+    compiled = Environment(loader=ModuleLoader(str(tmp_path)))
+    assert compiled.get_template("keep.html").render() == "selected"
+    for name in ["reject.html", "other.txt"]:
+        with pytest.raises(TemplateNotFound):
+            compiled.get_template(name)
